parts.refutation: Fails 'D+/D- steady voltage (V12)'. V12 (owner, 2026-09-28) answers what the USB protection may let reach USB_DP and USB_DM: steady 3.63 V. The TPD6E05U06 is a shunt clamp with VRWM 5.5 V and VBR 6.5 V min, 8.5 V max at 1 mA (SLVSBO7O section 5.4; Recommended Operating Conditions VIO 0 to 5.5 V). It does not conduct below its breakdown, so a steady fault between 3.63 V and 6.5 V, such as D+ shorted to a 5 V VBUS, reaches USB_DP or USB_DM through the 27 Ohm resistor unlimited. P2's own record states this ('It does not limit a steady external voltage between 3.63 V and its breakdown') and reports it separately under 'USB_DP and USB_DM steady overvoltage', yet marks the check as passing on the ground that the clamp 'adds no source'. That reading holds for every passive part and leaves the requirement empty. USB 2.0's 5V Short Circuit Withstand ECN removes the D+/D- short-to-VBUS withstand from the transceiver and states 'OEMs that require short circuit withstand to VBUS can implement the requirement with an external hub or other external protection circuitry', so a limit to 3.63 V needs a series element this part does not have. Every other requirement value passes. The failure is of the function's requirement against a shunt-clamp class, not of this part's maker, lifecycle or identity.

figures.evidence: Sources read as quoted. link_dev.h:25-31: 'the coprocessor gives up after 200 ms and the host escalates after 1 s, so the processor holding the outputs is the more suspicious of the two'; LINK_DEV_SILENCE_MS 200u. Safety.md:51: 'The panel is healthy and the coprocessor misbehaves ... no help: the panel is still beating'; 'no hardware in this design covers it'. IOBoard.md:186 and Monostable.md:28, :115 give 200 ms, 'the backstop is not slower than the link'. The panel stops the heartbeat only on STOP or an unserved disarm request (arming.c:192-197, panel main.c:716-717), an operator action, so with no action the watchdog is the only automatic stop path. The value is derived and marked as such ('A deadline read from the tree, not an owner figure')
